question: What preparatory act must precede reciting the mantra in the seventh Indra direction?
premises: The practitioner faces the seventh direction associated with Indra.
The practitioner takes up the thunderbolt.
The practitioner then recites the mantra.
inference: Recitation of the mantra requires first taking the thunderbolt in the specified direction.
uncertainties: The exact identification of the seventh Indra direction depends on ritual convention.
plain_english: Having taken the thunderbolt in the seventh, Indra's direction, one should recite the mantra.
